title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Installment Value on Reinstatement by Balance and Report Status
content:
The value given to each counted installment when a repayment plan on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is reinstated depends on the cancelled plan and on the balance now outstanding.

1. **Plan approved without a report, balance of 5,000.00 USD or more.** When the cancelled plan was approved without a Financial Status Report and the balance now outstanding is at least the re-figuring threshold of 5000.00 USD, each counted installment is re-figured as the current balance divided by the cancelled plan's number of months, rounded up to the cent.
2. **Balance below 1,000.00 USD, an installment paid.** When the balance now outstanding is below the small-balance limit of 1000.00 USD and at least one installment was paid, each counted installment is valued at the smallest plan installment of the debt type.
3. **Otherwise** each counted installment is valued at the installment approved for the cancelled plan.

Whether the cancelled plan carried a Financial Status Report, and its number of months, are read from the latest repayment plan request on the debt. An installment paid is a direct payment received on the debt.

| Debt type | Smallest plan installment (USD) used in clause 2 |
|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 25.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 25.00 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 50.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Report on the cancelled plan | Balance now | Installment paid | Installment value |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | 5,000.00 USD on a 12-month plan | Any | 5,000.00 divided by 12, that is 416.6666, rounded up: 416.67 USD |
| None | 4,999.99 USD | None | The approved installment (clause 3) |
| Attached | 7,200.00 USD | Any | The approved installment (clause 3) |
| Either | 999.99 USD on a Veterans Pension Overpayment | Yes | 25.00 USD |
| Either | 1,000.00 USD | Yes | The approved installment (clause 3) |
